question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can replace the underlined segment in the given sentence.

After suffering for a long time, Roy finally __passed away__ this month.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Breathed his last"** means to die or pass away. (अपना अंतिम सांस लेना) • **Example: **After battling illness for years, the old man breathed his last peacefully surrounded by his family. • The phrase **"After suffering for a long time, Roy finally passed away this month"** can be replaced with this idiom, as it signifies the end of life. (मृत्यु का संकेत देता है) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Brought down the house** (ज़बरदस्त मनोरंजन प्रदान करना): To give an outstanding performance that elicits great applause or appreciation. • **Example: **The comedian brought down the house with his hilarious jokes. • **Burnt his boats** (वापसी का कोई विकल्प न छोड़ना): To do something that makes it impossible to return to an earlier state or decision. • **Example:** By quitting his job so abruptly, he burnt his boats with the company. • **Blazed the trail** (रास्ता दिखाना या नई दिशा में शुरुआत करना): To be the first to do something or initiate a new path. • **Example:** She blazed the trail for women in the field of science. 38:Tcf3, The correct answer is: **Surrender**.
